newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BAKAYOKO HITS HITS SIX-MINUTE HAT-TRICK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAKAYOKO HITS HITS SIX-MINUTE HAT-TRICK.

text.p: Ivory Coast striker Ibrahim Bakayoko scored three goals in six minutes as Montpellier beat Lille 4-0 away in the French first division on Tuesday.

Montpellier, unbeaten in 10 league matches and 3-0 winners at Lille three weeks ago in the French Cup, dominated the match but did not manage to translate their control into goals until the 68th minute when Bakayoko scored his first.
He struck again two minutes later and completed a hat-trick in the 74th minute. Former France international Franck Sauzee added a fourth eight minutes from time.
